findings.evidence: 文件 services/aos-api/aos_api/ecommerce_three_module_closure_readonly.py 类 CreatorClosureReadonlyReader。read() 方法先校验 conn.read_only=True、autocommit=False、isolation_level=REPEATABLE_READ；取 transaction_timestamp() 作为 cutoff；对 closure/usage/effect/handoff 四个表按顺序执行 SELECT LIMIT 1，使用 MAX_ITEM_BYTES=64KB 和 MAX_TOTAL_BYTES=1MB 做 hask 体积门控；_decode 依次校验 scope、revision=1、_time(created_at/compiled_at/bound_at/observed_at/cutoff_at, cutoff)、tenant.org/project、row.content_hash vs model.content_hash、ledger(_ledger(items))、sourceRef/receiptRef/closureRef/usageReceiptRef/effectReviewRef/handoffRef revision、identity 派生规则（closure 为 three-module-closure-{hash[:24]}，binding 为 three-module-{kind}-{hash[:24]}）、payload canonical_hash。异常分类：psycopg.Error->UNAVAILABLE、类型错->AUTHORITY_DRIFT、红检失败->PRIVACY_UNAVAILABLE、超量->LIMIT_EXCEEDED。测试 test_ecommerce_three_module_closure_readonly.py 覆盖空结果（4 blockers+allowed_commands=[]）、outer/nested drift、ref 借用、ledger 篡改、SQL oversize、wrong transaction、backend 异常、敏感 actor、手风琴 ref、重复 item、wrong task kind 等 case；native 脚本 native_fixture_r2.py 报告 writeDeniedSqlstate='25006'、oversize->LIMIT_EXCEEDED、privacy->PRIVACY_UNAVAILABLE、commandsEmpty=true、originalVolumeTouched=false。
